Name: Gravity Falls Headwear
Author: dominodice23
Description:
Dipper's hat is labeled "Pine Tree Hat". Requires the [u]Artisan Achievement[/u]. Craft 30 different items to unlock this achievement.
Stanley's Fez is labeled "Mystery Fez". Requires the [u]Millionaire Achievement[/u]. Earn a total income of 1,000,000g to unlock this achievement.

You can purchase these hats at the hat shop.
(Replaces Trucker Hat and Bowler Hat)

How to Install:
1. Extract downloaded zipped folder
2. Open your Stardew Valley directory which is most likely located here: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley"
3. Paste "Content" folder from extracted zipped folder into your Stardew Valley directory.
4. Your PC will ask if you want the two "Content" folders merged. Click Yes.
5. Play!
Always back up the original content!
Have fun!

Where to find the hats:
1. Go to the catshop all the way below the forest where the Wizard's Tower is located.
2. Purchase hats for 1k each.
- Pine Tree Hat requires Artisan Achievement
- Mystery Fez Requires 1 Mil Achievement

Hat designs are based on the Disney cartoon "Gravity Falls" by Alex Hirsch.
